name: thunderdome
description: Agents compete on each task. The judge picks the best change. The winner ships.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:sample && npm run build:ui && node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sample && npm run build:ui && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.ui.json
scripts.test: npm run build:sample && npm run build:ui && vitest run
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings src test scripts image vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
